Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## What's new
- **Settlements card (Individual Expenses → Items):** whoever paid for items now also shows their own share under **Paid**, labelled "own share". The Paid column adds up to the full amount spent, next to what they received back.
- Includes everything from v1.7.1: stuck payment requests are closed automatically, duplicate requests are blocked, the payer's own share is marked "covered", and the Settlements table columns line up.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.7.2.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
